summary: The same Spanish leave law as Madrid (30 calendar days, Estatuto de los Trabajadores art. 38), but different holidays: the Comunitat Valenciana and València city set their own, so a Valencia colleague and a Madrid colleague are off on different days.

owner.role: Employment counsel (ES) + HR Business Partner Valencia

locationAssumption.citation: Employees assumed to work in València city (the Comunitat sets 12 holidays, the municipality 2)
locationAssumption.note: Groupon's 2026 postings place German-speaking sales and other roles in Valencia.

rule.citation: Estatuto de los Trabajadores art. 38.1: at least 30 calendar days; holidays inside a leave block are counted
rule.note: Audiencia Nacional 147/2026 (16 Sep 2026): natural days include weekends and holidays inside the block. Many convenios convert to 22 working days — check Groupon Spain's convenio.

source.citation: Decreto 42/2026, de 20 de marzo, del Consell (DOGV núm. 10329, 25 Mar 2026): 12 regional holidays for 2027; Valencia city locals 22 January and 5 April, approved by the city council
source.note: The regional dates were checked against the DOGV decree. The two city locals come from the Ajuntament's own announcement; the DOGV resolution is still pending (in 2026 it appeared in November).

rule.citation: ET art. 37.2: up to 14 holidays a year, 2 of them local; national holidays falling on a Sunday are moved to the Monday; no statutory replacement day for a holiday on a Saturday
ET art. 38.1: minimum 30 calendar days per year
Proportional to time worked in the year (~2.5 calendar days/month); front-loaded on 1 January (Groupon policy assumption)

ET art. 38.3: leave is taken within the year; if it coincides with pregnancy- or birth-related incapacity or a birth/adoption suspension it can be taken afterwards even after the year ends; for other incapacity, within 18 months of the end of the year
rule.note: The incapacity exceptions are not modelled.

rule.citation: ET art. 38.3: if incapacity coincides with the leave period, leave can be taken afterwards
rule.note: Incapacity arising during leave: CJEU C-78/11 (ANGED).

rule.citation: ET art. 38.1: leave "no sustituible por compensación económica"; payment only on termination (Tribunal Supremo, 28 May 2013)

extras.label: Convenio colectivo
extras.citation: The applicable sector convenio usually defines working-day counting and may add days
extras.note: Request Groupon Spain's convenio before go-live.
